g.text: gateway · chat · grafana · prometheus · tempo · argocd

svg.text: metrics · traces feed back from every layer above

g.text: Client (VS Code / Open WebUI / SDK) → Traefik → LiteLLM
LiteLLM validates virtual key → checks budget in Postgres
LiteLLM checks Redis cache → hit → return cached response
On miss, LiteLLM router → Ollama (least-busy pool)
Ollama runs inference on GPU or CPU pool
Metrics → Prometheus · Traces → OTel Collector → Tempo

svg.text: Designed to look like production, running entirely on a local workstation.
